d:
Bihar ke purv sansad aanand mohan ki samaypurv rihaee par suprim kort ne bara phaisla sunaya hai. adalat ne bihar sarkar ke 2023 ke jel niymon men kie gae sanshodhan ko asanvaidhanik ghoshit karte hue rihaee ka aadesh radd kar diya. aakhir nitish sarkar ne jel niymon men kya badlav kiya tha? kaise isi sanshodhan se aanand mohan ki rihaee ka rasta khula aur ab suprim kort ke phaisle se unki mushkilen phir barh gaeen? janie puri kahani.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
